summary: Frontend-only E2E test of Mafia game (3rd game added). Full happy-path walked: home → mafia card → intro → add 6 players → role counts (citizen=2, doctor=1, detective=1, mafia_leader=1, silencer_mafia=1, sum=6) → random distribution → reveal all 6 cards → night1 (doctor protect p0, mafia target p0 [should be saved], silencer silences p1, detective checks p2, sniper auto-skipped as no sniper role) → day results showed 'حماه الدكتور من المافيا' (CRITICAL: doctor save logic working) → discussion (silenced badge 'مسكَّت' visible on p1) → voting (5 voters since p1 silenced; cast 5 votes) → vote results (eliminated player shown with vote tally, e.g. 'لاعب1 4 أصوات', 'كان: دكتور') → continue → nightStart round 2 (game continues correctly since mafia=2 < citizens=3, no winner). Regression: domino & cards screens still load. All testIDs from spec are present and working. No red screens, no console errors (only RN-Web style deprecation warnings). Manual assign path (testID='assign-{i}', 'manual-assign-next') was not exercised end-to-end but code path was reviewed and looks consistent with random path.

issues: RN-Web console warnings: 'shadow*' / 'textShadow*' / 'props.pointerEvents' deprecations and 'useNativeDriver not supported' on web — non-blocking, cosmetic; main agent may migrate to boxShadow/textShadow/style.pointerEvents at convenience.

action_items: (Optional polish) Replace deprecated shadow*/textShadow*/pointerEvents props with boxShadow/textShadow/style.pointerEvents to silence web warnings.
(Optional) Add testID='manual-assign-next' E2E coverage in a follow-up to verify manual distribution end-to-end (code reviewed, looks correct).
critical_code_review_comments: mafia.tsx is ~1700+ lines (large). Consider splitting sub-screens (Intro/Players/RoleCounts/Distribution/Reveal/Night*/Discussion/Voting/End) into separate files for maintainability. Not a bug, just file size > 700 lines.

Resolution logic in resolveNight() correctly handles: doctor protect == mafia target (no death + 'حماه الدكتور' message), sniper-vs-protected, sniper-citizen mutual death — all verified by code review.
advanceNightFrom() correctly skips role phases when that role is not alive (verified: sniper phase auto-skipped during run since no sniper role was assigned).
aliveVoters memo correctly excludes silenced players, preventing them from voting (verified live: 5 voters from 6 alive).
seed_data_creation: None — Mafia state is in-memory only, no AsyncStorage/backend.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Mafia full happy path verified end-to-end via Playwright at https://mobile-game-design-3.preview.emergentagent.com (414x900 viewport). All testIDs in spec are present. Doctor-protect-vs-mafia, silencer-blocks-vote, and round transition all working. Bomber pull and end-game (winner) screens were not reached in this run because the random distribution + vote outcome did not trigger them; code paths were reviewed and look correct. Manual-assign path (testID='assign-{i}' + 'manual-assign-next') wasn't end-to-end exercised. Both regression games (domino, cards) still navigate from home.
rca_of_issue: No bugs found in this iteration.
